question: The ten title pages are built from your mock. Do they look right in the app?
context: Built from the mock you picked on 2026-10-18 (all ten, old set under More Styles). Reel: queue/audits/2026-10-18-apple-titles-reel.mp4. Mock beside app at 0, 25, 50, 100 percent of each entrance and the hold: queue/audits/2026-10-18-apple-titles-beside-mock.png. Mean pixel difference 0.2 to 2.8 of 255 for nine; Editorial 5.6 because of its serif cut.

options.label: Ship as built; Editorial keeps the Mac's headline serif
options.summary: All ten stay as the first title pages, the old set under More Styles. Editorial's headline uses the cut of New York the Mac draws at that size, a touch bolder and narrower than in the mock.
pros: Nine of ten match the mock frame for frame
Editorial's serif is the one Apple's own apps draw at headline size
cons: Editorial reads slightly heavier than the mock you approved
options.mitigation: Font, weight and spacing can still be changed per title in the panel.

options.label: Ship, but make Editorial's serif wider and lighter like the mock
options.summary: Same as a, and Editorial's headline is redrawn in the wider, lighter cut of New York the mock shows. That needs the app to choose a serif cut by hand, which is a follow-up build.
cons: One more build before Editorial is final
options.mitigation: The other nine ship now either way.

options.label: Some still look amateur: rework the ones I name
options.summary: Tell me which pages still look like a school presentation and what is wrong with them; those get reworked and the rest ship.
pros: Nothing ships that you do not like
cons: Needs your notes on which pages and why
options.mitigation: Comment straight on the reel lines in the audit.
